def.brief: Bounded non-author review of the last two fix commits (ca9c776 fx-build, 5078ffb gl-build+gl-tests) by a fresh Claude sub-agent: it opens the contract sections Q-review-fixes and Q-gitlink, the changed functions in dwitbuk.py and the new tests itself, probes renames, batching, excluded_diff, untracked nested repositories and tracked gitlinks on real temporary git repositories, and reports quoted findings; it changes no files and runs no broad mutation campaign. The verifier accepts on fx-build (a Grep) and gl-build (one Read of dwitbuk.py) stay as recorded.

non-claims: no check decides this task; done means the agent said so
fix-review: done on the session's word by name (`run fix-review`), with nothing of its own in the tree and no `did`
fix-review: done by the session's sub-agent — chongdae saw the session and the tree, not the sub-agent; its model is the session's unless the session dispatched it with another

trace.command-lines: kept in the local session transcript, not in the record
trace.elsewhere: 4 command(s) or edit(s) outside this project, kept only in the local session
